notes: Refused BEFORE anything is written, for this install_id's row carrying revoked_at.
The refusal is what makes a revoke stick for the same install_id instead of being undone by the app's next launch.
Silence would be worse than the sentence: the app must be able to say which state it is in instead of showing a registered device that never receives anything.
